rows.grounds: the praṇava/bīja syllable; mantra material transliterated by function
the verbal formula or word to be spoken

items.question: What specific mantra formula must the practitioner utter in this ritual context?
premises: tāraḥ denotes the sacred syllable Oṃ.
namaḥ expresses obeisance to the named deities.
śivāyai and nārāyaṇyai identify the recipients as Śivā and Nārāyaṇī.
vadet instructs that this padaṃ be uttered.
items.inference: The practitioner should utter the formula: tāraḥ, namaḥ, śivāyai, ca, nārāyaṇyai.
items.plain_english: One should utter the formula: Oṃ, obeisance to Śivā and to Nārāyaṇī.
